name: line-count
input: path to an existing valid UTF-8 file, or a missing path
output: Ok(number of elements produced by Rust-style str.lines()) or Err(IoError::NotFound)
line_semantics: split on LF, strip a CR immediately before LF, omit a final empty element after a trailing LF; empty input has zero lines
limits: files fit in memory; line count fits i32; invalid UTF-8 and other I/O failures are outside this baseline contract
